_notes: Single source for the Resonant Impact demo. Read by FlipThe7Seas/resonant-impact-js (JS) and fantasy-text-game (Godot, via a symlink).
Inline tags: [style|words]. Styles: big shout laugh whisper cold hot glow forest warm sad fall.
Line emotions (emo): worried happy laugh incredulous sad thoughtful awe.
who: 'u' = Unknown, 'a' = Ancel. reveal: name shown once the typewriter reaches it.
choices: to = next node | 'OVER' | 'END'; aff = affinity; q = hub question id; input = name entry; death = marks Certain Death.
q1-q4 and bye are placeholder lore - rewrite freely.

races.name: Human
races.desc: The most common people of Anbur, who chiefly populate the holy land. Less accustomed to the Eternal Forest, but the most versatile of all.

races.name: Elf
races.desc: Their vast knowledge has even led to a moderate understanding of divine power — at the expense of physical capability.

races.name: Dwarf
races.desc: Their reduction in height has done nothing to reduce their physical prowess nor their moderate intelligence — but they see themselves as beyond the need for magic tricks.

races.name: Endigo
races.desc: The tribalistic people of the Eternal Forest, who almost never venture toward the holy lands. A deft understanding of casting magics, but largely naive to the world at large.

d1.cap: Your eyes open. A kind elven mage leans over you, his hand outstretched.
d1.text: Hey! [big|Are you okay?] Let me help you up!

choices.t: Swat the elf’s hand away and get up on your own.
choices.say: You swat his hand away and stand.

d2a.text: Hey, friend! Pretty bold to take a nap so close to the [glow|Holy Trove] like that! You’re lucky you didn’t [fall|fall in!]

d2b.text: [shout|WOAH!] [laugh|Ha!] Somebody woke up on the [glow|Trove] of the bed this morning!

d3.cap: Past his shoulder, the forest floor falls away into a vast pit. It seems to have no bottom at all.
d3.text: Now you’re pulling my leg! You can’t live in the [glow|Radial Perimeter] without knowing about the [glow|Holy Trove!] It’s the only reason most of us are this far into the [forest|Eternal Forest!] [big|What else could you be doing here?]

d4.text: [sad|No way…] You remember your name at least, right? [warm|I’m Ancel!]

d5.text: Pleased to meet you, [warm|{name}!] Do you know which [glow|Perimeter Town] you’re from? I could walk you back!

d6.text: [sad|Another blank, huh?] Your nap is seeming less intentional by the minute… [happy|how ’bout this.] You can join me while I head back to town, and we’ll see if we can’t [warm|jog up some of those memories!]

choices.t: For a game about impactful choices, this is some serious railroading.

hub.cap: Ancel sets off along a winding path between the ancient trees. You follow.
hub.text: [shout|Awesome!] Follow me! Ask me [warm|anything] you like!

choices.t: That’s all the questions I had!

q1.text: The [glow|Holy Trove] is the pit you nearly rolled into! [whisper|Nobody’s ever found the bottom.] Every so often it gives something back up — and that’s what draws us all out here.

choices.t: That’s all the questions I had!

q2.text: It’s the great ring of settlements around the Trove. Close enough to reach it in a day, far enough that the [cold|deep forest] mostly leaves us alone.

choices.t: That’s all the questions I had!

q3.text: This! All of it! The [forest|Eternal Forest] goes on further than anyone’s ever mapped. [cold|The trees here don’t die.] [whisper|They just keep growing.]

choices.t: That’s all the questions I had!

q4.text: Little towns strung along the Perimeter. Mine’s a short walk east — [hot|warm hearths], [laugh|terrible stew], and more Trove-seekers than beds.

choices.t: That’s all the questions I had!

bye.text: Then let’s get moving, [warm|{name}!] Town’s this way — and [cold|stay close.]
